v3.fact: DeviceInfo entry is used only as archive recognition; output device=None. Profiles receive performance=None. Feature XML without a <Mappings substring is skipped, including DPI, DPIStages, polling and power.
DKM_M_03/04 become Naga thumb_03/04; DKM_SB_03 is dropped with a warning.
Only KeyGroup, MouseGroup and MacroGroup are recognized; SensitivityGroup and unknown groups become Disabled. raw_mapping=None prevents downstream recovery or exact unknown-field detection.
Only boolean modifier families survive; original right/left modifier and full raw source options are not retained.

v4.fact: Serde mirrors do not retain unknown fields. Extra profile features, nested keyboard options and per-stage visibility/index/count metadata can disappear before app conversion. raw_mapping serializes the restricted mirror rather than the original JSON.

The shared Naga mapping dictionary is reused. Bottom DPI alias is dropped; side aliases get Naga control IDs. Some outputs are explicitly Unmappable, but their missing raw group fields cannot be reconstructed downstream.

required_evidence_and_implementation: Establish actual exported DeviceInfo identity schema and conflicting identity rejection for exact B6/B7; factory defaults are not an exported device identity fixture.
Retain complete raw feature and mapping blocks before normalization, including every unknown field, and block candidate creation for unsupported content.
Resolve model-specific DKM aliases per layer and reject conflicting aliases or duplicate physical controls rather than copying the Naga table.
Parse full XY stage table, root active selection, enabled/visible stage semantics and connection-specific polling rate without clamping or flattening.
Distinguish known disabled/default bindings from sensitivity, Hypershift, media, macro, calibration and unknown output groups; retain source options and exact modifier sides.
Do not import DA macros or text as software macros until exact mouse input ownership is implemented. No customizable RGB is established for this model.

Only after those semantics are preserved, convert supported actions, persist/reload imported Profile and replay through the production native simulation. No executable DA Profile is produced by the current refusal gate.
